title: AI/ML Webinar Series
description:
6-part webinar series covering machine learning fundamentals, neural networks, NLP, and deploying models to production. Free and open to all skill levels.

Each session includes live coding demos, Q&A with experts, and access to recorded sessions for revision.
highlights: 6-Part Series, Live Coding, Expert Q&A, Recorded Sessions, Certificate

title: Antigravity Design Summit 2026
description:
A premier gathering of designers and creatives pushing the boundaries of modern aesthetics. Featuring keynote speakers, hands-on workshops, and networking sessions in a stunning venue.

Join 500+ designers, product leaders, and creative technologists for two days of inspiration, learning, and collaboration. From UI/UX masterclasses to brand strategy deep-dives, this summit covers the full spectrum of modern design.
highlights: Keynote Speakers, Hands-on Workshops, Networking Sessions, Portfolio Reviews, Design Awards, After-Party

title: Startup Pitch Night
description:
Watch 10 hand-picked startups pitch their ideas to a panel of top VCs and angel investors. Networking reception follows with founders and investors.

An evening of innovation, inspiration, and investment. Meet the next wave of disruptive startups and connect with the investor community.
highlights: Live Pitches, Investor Panel, Networking Reception, Startup Demos

title: Community Meetup: Web3 & Beyond
description:
Monthly community meetup exploring decentralized technologies, blockchain development, and the future of the web. Lightning talks, demos, and pizza.

Whether you're a blockchain veteran or just curious about Web3, this meetup is your gateway to the decentralized future.
highlights: Lightning Talks, Live Demos, Pizza & Drinks, Open Discussions

title: Future of Tech Conference
description:
Explore the latest innovations in AI, cloud computing, and DevOps. Connect with industry leaders and gain insights into the technologies shaping tomorrow.

Two days packed with technical talks, live demos, and hands-on labs covering everything from generative AI to serverless architectures.
highlights: AI & ML Talks, Cloud Workshops, DevOps Labs, Startup Showcase, Panel Discussions

title: Creative Code Workshop
description:
An immersive workshop where art meets technology. Learn to create stunning generative art, interactive installations, and dynamic web experiences using code.

Perfect for designers who want to code and developers who want to create art. No prior creative coding experience required.
highlights: Generative Art, Interactive Installations, Live Coding, Certificate of Completion

title: DevOps Bootcamp 2026
description:
Intensive 2-day bootcamp covering Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure as code. Hands-on labs with real-world cloud environments.

Get certified-ready with practical exercises on AWS, GCP, and Azure. Limited seats to ensure personal mentoring.
highlights: Docker & Kubernetes, CI/CD Pipelines, Cloud Labs, Mentorship, Certificate
